title: Mahinda Rajapaksa leaves Bribery Commission
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa departed the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) after providing a statement for nearly two hours.

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa says fair probe will clear him
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, who was summoned before the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC), expressed confidence in the proceedings as he arrived to provide a statement.

title: Man dies after spending night in lodge with woman
byline: A 46- year old man spending Sunday night at a lodge with a woman had developed a sudden illness and died on admission to Mahiyangane hospital.

title: Ongoing rainy weather makes Ditwah- triggered landslide active again
byline: A landslide triggered by the Ditwah cyclone last year has become active once again as a result of the ongoing rainy weather which has hit Watawala in the Badulla district, authorities said yesterday.

title: Crackdown on criminal activities in rented properties
byline: Police have issued a warning to property owners over the increasing use of rented houses, apartments and commercial buildings for illegal activities, including organised crime and online financial fraud.

title: Cyber thefts: India, Sri Lanka discuss cooperation for containment in future
byline: In the wake of cyber thefts affecting the Government’s financial activities, Sri Lanka and India have initiated discussions for cooperation to pre-empt such threats in the future, Daily Mirror learns.

title: US issues new sanctions over Iran’s oil shipments to China
byline: The U.S. government on Monday announced sanctions against three people and ​nine companies, including four based in Hong Kong and four in the United Arab Emirates, for ‌aiding Iran’s shipment of oil to China. The ninth company is based in Oman.

title: Mahinda Rajapaksa appears before Bribery Commission
byline: Former President Mahinda Rajapaksa appeared before the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) a short while ago to provide a statement in connection with the investigation into the controversial 2013 Airbus procurement deal involving SriLankan Airlines.

title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on ’massive life support’
byline: US President Donald Trump has said the month-long ceasefire between the US and Iran is on ’’massive life support’’.

title: Court affirms students’ right to inspect marked scripts
byline: While upholding the Right to Information Commission’s decision that the RTI Act prevails over the University By-Laws, the Court of Appeal held that there cannot be hide-and-seek games in higher educational institutions and that every examinee has the right to access their evaluated answer scripts.

title: Man dies following shooting in Galle
byline: A man who sustained critical injuries in a shooting incident at Dickson Junction in Dangedara, Galle, has died after being admitted to the hospital.

title: 198 foreign nationals arrested in Southern Province over cybercrimes
byline: Sri Lankan police have arrested 198 foreign nationals across three locations in the Southern Province on suspicion of involvement in organized cybercrime. The raids took place in Midigama, Hikkaduwa, and Galle, targeting groups allegedly operating digital fraud centers.

title: Man accused of attempting to assassinate Trump pleads not guilty
byline: The man accused ‌of attempting to assassinate U.S. President Donald Trump at a White House reporters’ gala last month pleaded not guilty to all charges on Monday.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay meets former CM MK Stalin day after oath-taking
byline: Tamil Nadu’s new Chief Minister Vijay on Monday met his predecessor and DMK chief MK Stalin, a day after the actor-turned-politician was sworn in following a landmark election victory.

title: Dua Lipa sues Samsung for $15m over use of her image on TV boxes
byline: Pop star Dua Lipa has filed a $15m (£11m) lawsuit against Samsung, alleging it used her image on packaging for its televisions without permission.

title: Peradeniya Professor barred from academic posts over sexual harassment allegations
byline: The Supreme Court directed the University Grants Commission (UGC) to bar a Professor attached to the University of Peradeniya from receiving any appointment, whether paid, unpaid or honorary, in any university or academic institution under its purview, following allegations of sexual harassment and emotional abuse of a junior lecturer.

title: Al Mubarak National School holds new scouts investiture ceremony
byline: The Al Mubarak National School Scout Group in Malwana held its New Scouts Investiture Ceremony on Sunday (10) at the school premises with the participation of students, parents, and invited guests.

title: Sri Lanka opens Mattala airport to local, foreign investors
byline: Sri Lanka has launched a drive to attract local and foreign investors to the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA) as part of efforts to revive the aviation sector and boost economic growth in the country’s south.

title: Two suspects remanded over Kapila’s suspicious bail surety arrangement
byline: Two more suspects arrested for allegedly arranging sureties for former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena, who was granted bail while in remand custody over the procurement of a fleet of ten aircraft for SriLankan Airlines in 2013, were ordered to be remanded till tomorrow by Colombo Additional Magistrate Lahiru Silva today.

title: Man shot at, hacked to death in Ambalantota, revenge suspected
byline: The Ambalantota Police have launched an investigation following a brutal homicide committed last night.

title: Vijitha Herath to undertake official visit to Belarus
byline: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath is scheduled to undertake an official visit to Belarus from 12 to 15 May 2026 on the invitation of the Foreign Minister of the Republic of Belarus, Maxim Ryzhenkov, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism said.

title: Ratnapura rest house, 3 shops fined for overpricing essentials
byline: A well-known rest house in Ratnapura and three rice-selling shops have been fined by the Ratnapura Magistrate’s Court for selling essential items above the approved prices.

title: Everyone must abide by law irrespective of their positions: President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said today that the law will be implemented against anyone, while stressing that everyone must abide by the law irrespective of their positions.

title: Vijay’s personal astrologer gets a post in Tamil Nadu government
byline: TVK chief Vijay’s astrologer Thiru Rickey Radhan Pandit Vettrivel has been appointed Officer on Special Duty (OSD) to the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on Tuesday.

title: Schools in Deniyaya reopen tomorrow after viral fever outbreak
byline: The four schools in the Deniyaya Education Zone that were temporarily closed following the rapid spread of a viral fever among students, will reopen tomorrow (13), Southern Province Education Secretary Nishan Pathirana said.

title: Namal condemns alleged intimidation of journalists at Ragala Estate
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP Namal Rajapaksa has expressed concern over reports that journalists and social activists visiting Delmar Estate in Ragala were allegedly threatened and intimidated.

title: Cabinet approves amendments to animals act
byline: The Cabinet has approved a proposal to amend the Animals Act No. 29 of 1958 to expand the definition of “animal” by including pigs, goats and sheep in addition to cattle and cows.

title: Cabinet awards Central Expressway contracts
byline: The Cabinet has approved the awarding of seven construction contracts for Phase 2 of Section 3 of the Central Expressway Project from Rambukkana to Galagedara.

title: Government trying to woo SJBers because of its failure: Tissa
byline: Responding to certain reports claiming that (Samagi Jana Balawegaya) SJBers are to join the government, National Organiser of the party Tissa Attanayake said today that some are being wooed to join the government to cover up its failures.

title: Market ends mixed as cautious sentiment persists amid global uncertainty
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange ended today’s session on a mixed note, with both indices fluctuating within a narrow range as investor sentiment remained cautious amid ongoing uncertainty surrounding the Iran–USA negotiations and rising global commodity prices.

title: Rs. 1.2 mn compensation issued to Uma Oya affected families
byline: The Cabinet Subcommittee has taken steps to provide permanent solutions to long-standing land issues faced by residents in the Welimada, Uva Paranagama and Hali Ela Divisional Secretariat divisions due to the Uma Oya project.

title: Southern California mayor resigns, will plead guilty to acting as agent for Chinese government
byline: A Southern California mayor has agreed to plead guilty to acting as an illegal agent for the Chinese government, and has resigned from her city position, officials said Monday.

title: Stent shortage - Galle Hospital denies Sajith Premadasa’s claims
byline: The National Hospital Galle has refuted reports claiming a shortage of stents at the hospital, following statements made by Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa.

title: At least nine people killed in explosion at Pakistan market
byline: An explosion in a busy market in northwestern Pakistan has killed at least nine people and wounded 30, according to emergency workers and a medical official.

title: Dengue cases rise; 14 deaths reported this year
byline: A rise in dengue patients has been reported across the country compared to last year, the National Dengue Control Unit said.

title: Heavy rains to continue across Sri Lanka for next few days
byline: The Meteorology Department has forecast continued rainy conditions across the island over the next few days due to the influence of a low-pressure area located northeast of Sri Lanka.

title: Raids on drug-using drivers continue: 7 detected in Kadawatha operation
byline: The Transport, Highways and Urban Development Ministry has continued its islandwide crackdown on drivers using dangerous drugs, with seven individuals detected during a special operation held at the Kadawatha bus stand today (12).

title: My allegation on Karapitiya Hospital was based on true facts: Sajith
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa, who refuted the claims by the authorities of the Karapitiya Hospital that there was no shortage of stents and other equipment said his allegation was based on true facts.

title: Probe should be conducted on Kaplia Chandrasena’s affidavit: GL
byline: A probe should be conducted to determine the truth on the allegations made by former Srilankan Airlines Chief Kaplia Chandrasena who  mentioned in his affidavit prior to his death, Former Minister Professor G. L . Peris said today.

title: Uganda’s president sworn in for record seventh term
byline: Uganda’s President Yoweri Museveni, 81, has been sworn in for a record seventh consecutive term following his landslide victory in disputed elections in January, extending his tenure as one of Africa’s longest-serving rulers.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay makes first intervention on Indo-Lanka fishermen issue
byline: New Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has urged External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar to take immediate diplomatic action to secure the release of 54 Indian fishermen and 264 fishing boats currently detained by Sri Lankan authorities, following the latest arrest of six fishermen by the Sri Lanka Navy.

title: State intervention sought to tackle drugs, social decline through religious revival
byline: The Buddhasasana Sabha has called for stronger state intervention to address the growing social issues including drug abuse, declining religious discipline and challenges faced by the Buddhist community.

title: Southern California mayor resigns, will plead guilty to acting as agent for Chinese government
byline: A Southern California mayor has agreed to plead guilty to acting as an illegal agent for the Chinese government, and has resigned from her city position, officials said Monday.

title: Bangladesh outclass Pakistan and boost WTC27 push
byline: Bangladesh secured their first win of the ICC World Test Championship 2025–27 cycle with a commanding victory over Pakistan in the first Test in Mirpur.

title: At least nine people killed in explosion at Pakistan market
byline: An explosion in a busy market in northwestern Pakistan has killed at least nine people and wounded 30, according to emergency workers and a medical official.
